content:
alex (devex): Observed duplicated side-effects after a POST got a 429 with a Retry-After header. The client retried immediately instead of waiting. Truncated response: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nRetry-After: 12\n...`

meera (sdk): Do you have an Idempotency-Key on the request? For mutating endpoints we expect clients/SDK to set one. The SDK auto-generates one in the sync path but I think there's a gap for chunked/streaming calls. Two quick checks: 1) ensure retry logic honors Retry-After (sleep by the header value in seconds) and 2) for other 5xx/429 without Retry-After use capped exponential backoff + full jitter.

alex (devex): repro steps: POST /v1/actions/run with JSON payload, server returned 429+Retry-After, our server log shows the SDK call had no Idempotency-Key. Short log: `Request-Id: 01GZ... | Headers: {Accept: application/json}` (no Idempotency-Key).

meera (sdk): yep that matches a bug we flagged last sprint  the auto-gen hook doesn't run for requests that are streamed/chunked. Fix plan: - always attach Idempotency-Key at request start for non-GET/DELETE mutating ops - if Retry-After present, block/sleep for that duration before retrying - for 5xx without Retry-After, backoff: min=100ms, factor=2, cap=5s, full jitter.

python example (for sync client):
```python
# generate once per logical operation
headers["Idempotency-Key"] = str(uuid.uuid4())
resp = session.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
if resp.status_code == 429 and "Retry-After" in resp.headers:
    time.sleep(int(resp.headers["Retry-After"]))
```

sam (platform): A couple nuances: for streaming responses you can't safely retry the same connection on a mid-stream failure  you must treat stream failures as non-retriable for resume and start a fresh request. 429 should strongly prefer honoring Retry-After header; 5xx should use backoff+jitter. For Node we recommend configs like p-retry: `{retries:5, minTimeout:200, factor:2, randomize:true}`. Also suggest a metric: `sdk.retries.retry_after_honored` to detect when Retry-After is ignored. :thinking:

meera (sdk): Test plan: add unit test that simulates 429 w/ Retry-After=1 three times then returns 200 and assert only one side-effect recorded. Add integration test to exercise chunked upload/streaming path to ensure Idempotency-Key is attached before any chunk is sent. Also update docs for language clients about streaming vs sync behaviors.

alex (devex): great. Ping me when PR is up and assign @sam for platform review. I'm planning to cut a minor patch release once merged.

ci-bot: PR opened: refs/pull/8431 by meera/sdk/streaming-idempotency-fix  tests added (unit + integration mocking Retry-After); CI started -> https://ci.redwood/8431

sam (platform): I'll review today. Also +1 for the metric; we should add a small e2e that simulates 429+Retry-After under load to make sure we don't spin.

meera (sdk): noted. Adding metric and e2e ticket to board. Will include a short doc blurb about streaming edge cases for the SDK readme.

alex (devex): thanks both. tagging ops in case they see any duplicate operations in the telemetry: @ops-team :thumbsup:

ops-team: acknowledged, will watch for duplicates and correlate by request-id. If we see repeats we can roll back the client quickly or apply a server-side idempotency gate.

alex (devex): closing loop: once PR merges I'll publish patch and add a changelog note about "fix: ensure Idempotency-Key for streamed mutating requests; honor Retry-After header".
